RexxarSpiritSwoopBirdOfPrey.name: Bird of Prey
RexxarSpiritSwoopBirdOfPrey.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's damage by 150% to Minions.

RexxarSpiritBondEasyPrey.name: Easy Prey
RexxarSpiritBondEasyPrey.description: Increases Misha's basic attack damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 150%, and Misha gains 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing damage taken by 50%.

RexxarFlare.name: Flare
RexxarFlare.description: Fire a flare at an area, revealing it for 20 seconds.

RexxarHungryBear.name: Hungry Bear
RexxarHungryBear.description: Misha's Basic Attacks heal her for 4.5% of her maximum Health.

RexxarHunterGatherer.name: Hunter-Gatherer
RexxarHunterGatherer.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Rexxar and Misha's Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 25 per second. Reward: After gathering 25 Globes, Rexxar and Misha gain 15 Armor.

RexxarSpiritBondGrizzledFortitude.name: Grizzled Fortitude
RexxarSpiritBondGrizzledFortitude.description: Every 6 seconds, Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 2 charges. Both Rexxar and Misha have their own charges.

RexxarAnimalHusbandry.name: Animal Husbandry
RexxarAnimalHusbandry.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 2 Maximum Health every second Rexxar remains alive. These bonuses are lost on Rexxar's death.

RexxarSpiritSwoopCripplingTalons.name: Crippling Talons
RexxarSpiritSwoopCripplingTalons.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's slow amount to 50% and its duration to 3.5 seconds.

RexxarTakingFlightSpiritSwoop.name: Taking Flight
RexxarTakingFlightSpiritSwoop.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's range by 20%. If Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, the Mana cost is refunded and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

RexxarAspectoftheBeastCharge.name: Aspect of the Beast
RexxarAspectoftheBeastCharge.description: Misha's Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Misha, Charge! by 1 second.

RexxarHeroicAbilityBestialWrath.name: Bestial Wrath
RexxarHeroicAbilityBestialWrath.description: Increases Misha's Basic Attack damage by 200% for 12 seconds.

RexxarHeroicAbilityUnleashTheBoars.name: Unleash the Boars
RexxarHeroicAbilityUnleashTheBoars.description: Release a herd of boars that track down all enemy Heroes in a direction, dealing 110 damage, revealing, and slowing enemies by 40% for 5 seconds.

RexxarAspectOfTheHawkSpiritSwoop.name: Aspect of the Hawk
RexxarAspectOfTheHawkSpiritSwoop.description: When Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, Rexxar gains 125% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Misha's Basic Attacks increase the duration of this buff by 0.75 seconds.

RexxarDireBeast.name: Dire Beast
RexxarDireBeast.description: Rexxar and Misha's Basic Attacks increase the damage of the next Misha, Charge! by 15%, stacking up to a 150% bonus.

RexxarSpiritBondWildfireBear.name: Wildfire Bear
RexxarSpiritBondWildfireBear.description: Misha deals 28 damage per second to nearby enemies.

RexxarThrilloftheHunt.name: Thrill of the Hunt
RexxarThrilloftheHunt.description: Rexxar's Basic Attacks increase both his and Misha's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

RexxarSpiritBondPrimalIntimidation.name: Primal Intimidation
RexxarSpiritBondPrimalIntimidation.description: Activate to Slow the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of Heroes and Summons near Rexxar and Misha for 2.5 seconds. Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack Rexxar or Misha have their Attack Speed slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

RexxarFeignDeath.name: Feign Death
RexxarFeignDeath.description: Rexxar fakes his death, becoming Invulnerable and untargetable for 5 seconds. During this time you control Misha.

RexxarSpiritBond.name: Spirit Bond
RexxarSpiritBond.description: Increases the duration of Bestial Wrath by 50% and Misha's Basic Attacks heal Rexxar for 50% of her damage dealt during Bestial Wrath.

RexxarUnleashTheBoarsKillCommand.name: Kill Command
RexxarUnleashTheBoarsKillCommand.description: Unleash the Boars deals 50% more damage and Roots for 1.5 seconds.

RexxarFrenzyofKalimdor.name: Frenzy of Kalimdor
RexxarFrenzyofKalimdor.description: Rexxar's Basic Attacks deal 10% more damage, and Misha's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1.25 seconds.

RexxarHardenedSkin.name: Hardened Skin
RexxarHardenedSkin.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.
